scene:
Three unlabelled areas read left to right, separated by generous space; do not number, title or name the areas.

LEFT AREA, sizing the need: one tall vertical stacked column of six blocks, built from the bottom up. The bottom block is the largest, teal, with a small gear icon, labelled to its right BUILD €180K. Above it five thinner ochre blocks, each labelled to its right, bottom to top: MAINTENANCE (small wrench icon), TRANSITION (two parallel arrows), SPECIALIST (a person with a clipboard), ALLOWANCE (a small cushion), RUNWAY (a short road). A horizontal brace sits on top of the whole column, and above it, written horizontally (not rotated), the label NEED €610K.

MIDDLE AREA, two funding cards stacked vertically, with a navy arrow from the column to each. Upper card: a large pile of plain coins beside a globe with a fast-forward arrow and a padlock over a blank ruled sheet (no heading or word on the sheet), labelled GROWTH EQUITY €2.5M; the card is crossed by one thin navy diagonal line and carries a small tag labelled TOO FAST. Lower card: a bank building beside a calendar with four equal payment slots, labelled BANK LOAN €750K; it carries a large ochre check mark and a stamp labelled CHOSEN.

RIGHT AREA, the dated review: at the top a calendar page with a small group of eight customer figures and a stopwatch with a plain face and no digits, labelled DAY 100 REVIEW. Below it three horizontal bands stacked top to bottom, each a rounded bar with one icon: a teal bar with an upward arrow, labelled UNDER 60 HOURS: EXPAND; an ochre bar with a small data table and a wrench, labelled 60–70 HOURS: FIX DATA; a navy-outlined pale bar with a looping arrow, labelled OVER 70 HOURS: RETHINK.

All coins are plain discs with no symbols; draw no dollar, euro or other currency signs on any object. Buildings, documents, calendars, screens and people carry no words, letters or numerals of their own. No chapter title, heading or book name anywhere.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: BUILD €180K, MAINTENANCE, TRANSITION, SPECIALIST, ALLOWANCE, RUNWAY, NEED €610K, GROWTH EQUITY €2.5M, TOO FAST, BANK LOAN €750K, CHOSEN, DAY 100 REVIEW, UNDER 60 HOURS: EXPAND, 60–70 HOURS: FIX DATA, OVER 70 HOURS: RETHINK. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A stacked column sizes the need at €610,000: a €180,000 build plus maintenance, transition, a contract specialist, an allowance and runway; of two funding cards, €2.5 million of growth equity is crossed out as too fast and a €750,000 bank loan is chosen; a day-100 review routes under 60 hours per customer to expansion, 60 to 70 hours to fixing data, and over 70 hours to rethinking.
caption: Size the whole need, pick the arrangement whose terms fit the work, and set a dated review that decides what happens next.
